title: Wetlands Vanish 3 Times Faster Than Forests
hook: Wetlands disappeared 3 times faster than forests, taking natural flood protection.
closing: Losing wetlands means dirtier water and fewer buffers against floods.
question: What wetland protects your area?

segments.say: Since 1970, the world lost 35% of its wetlands, shrinking natural water filters.
Wetlands vanish about 3 times faster than forests, despite protecting water and absorbing floods.
Europe lost half its wetlands since 1970, the worst regional decline.
